profile.headline: Engineering manager returning to hands-on full-stack engineering

preferences.notes: Deliberately returning to hands-on individual contributor work after managing a team of eight. Not looking for management, director or head-of roles. Remote within the EU or hybrid in Lisbon.

Software Engineer, Harbourline Studio, Porto, 2014–2017
